name: Palo Alto Device Critical Event
description: Detects a PAN-OS threat record marked critical. This is the highest PAN-OS severity classification and requires prompt review, but it does not by itself prove that a system was compromised.
note:
## What this alert shows

A Palo Alto firewall recorded a threat event with critical severity. The alert is a warning that needs prompt review; it does not by itself prove that an attack succeeded or that the affected system is compromised.

## What to check

Review the source and destination addresses, time, threat name, application, destination port, firewall action, security rule, and whether the traffic was allowed, blocked, or dropped. Check related events from the same source or destination, including authentication, endpoint, and other threat alerts. Confirm with the owner of the destination system whether the activity was expected.

## Safe response

Preserve the relevant logs and escalate promptly to the SOC or system owner when the activity is unexplained, allowed, repeated, or supported by other evidence. Do not automatically block traffic, isolate a system, reset passwords, or disable accounts based on this alert alone; use the approved incident-response process after confirming the facts and possible operational impact.
query: event.dataset:"panw.panos" and panw.panos.type:"THREAT" and event.kind:alert and event.severity:1
